title: Wicked Problem, Parsimonious Solution: Securing Electric Vehicle Charging Station Software
abstract: arXiv:2609.10502v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Electric vehicle charging infrastructure presents a suite of novel cyber-physical threats. Among this infrastructure, charging stations are the most vulnerable elements. The software in the charging station supply equipment is particularly vulnerable. Currently, the software is an attack surface that is largely unprotected and poorly characterized. To represent the vulnerabilities in this attack surface, we advocate for applying modern software quality assurance to characterize vulnerabilities in electric vehicle charging station software. Specifically, we advocate for the application of hierarchical software quality assurance (HSQA) to specialized electric vehicle charging station software. HSQA provides a comprehensive view of the code quality and security -- from the level of individual vulnerabilities (e.g., CVEs) to high level characteristics (e.g., CIA Triad). translated_title: 棘手问题，简约解决方案：保障电动汽车充电站软件安全
translated_abstract: 电动汽车充电基础设施带来了一系列新颖的网络物理威胁。在这些基础设施中，充电站是最脆弱的环节。充电站供电设备中的软件尤其容易受到攻击。目前，该软件是一个在很大程度上未受保护且特征不明的攻击面。为了表征这一攻击面中的漏洞，我们倡导应用现代软件质量保证方法来识别电动汽车充电站软件中的漏洞。具体而言，我们倡导将分层软件质量保证（HSQA）应用于专用的电动汽车充电站软件。HSQA提供了代码质量与安全性的全面视图——从单个漏洞层面（如CVE）到高层特性层面（如CIA三元组）。HSQA在整个软件开发生命周期中融入了质量和安全方面的考量。
tldr: 该论文提出将分层软件质量保证（HSQA）方法应用于电动汽车充电站软件，通过从单个漏洞到高层安全特性（如CIA三元组）的全面视图，系统性地表征和解决充电站软件这一易受攻击的攻击面问题。
en_tdlr: This paper advocates applying hierarchical software quality assurance (HSQA) to electric vehicle charging station software, providing a comprehensive view from individual vulnerabilities (e.g., CVEs) to high-level characteristics (e.g., CIA Triad) to address the largely unprotected attack surface of charging station software.
